reason: I don't want my clients' tone and audience details sitting in a tool I've never heard of, and it doesn't plug into my scheduler, so it's one more tab where I copy and paste. I already get captions out of the AI I use; this adds another place to manage.
objection: Client data in an unknown tool, and no publishing or scheduler integration. Client approvals, which are my real bottleneck over WhatsApp, are only 'coming later'.
would_change_my_mind: A direct integration with Metricool or Buffer, plus working client approvals and clear statements on where client data is stored and that it isn't used for training.
